far_nzy_economy_design_implications.fd_earn_rate_recommendation: FD daily free earn should be sufficient for 1–2 game sessions without purchase. Scarcity felt at session 3+.
far_nzy_economy_design_implications.pdx_pricing_recommendation: Entry tier $1.99–$4.99 captures broadest audience. High-value tier $49.99–$99.99 for whales. 5–6 tier ladder optimal per benchmarks.
far_nzy_economy_design_implications.sdx_scarcity_recommendation: SDX items must be blockchain-verified (confirmed on @match3d/blockchain before SDX balance increments). Seasonal limited drops create urgency without inflating supply.
far_nzy_economy_design_implications.daily_reward_recommendation: Login streak calendar (Day 1–30) is industry standard and essential for D1/D7/D30 retention. Streak reset on miss increases urgency. FD daily allocation is the reward token.
far_nzy_economy_design_implications.npns_structural_requirement: AMOE must provide genuine FD and PDX-entry pathway. IEventStore must enforce purchase-free path at schema level — not just UI level.
